decisions.executionNote: Begin continuous elbow-up lift and wrist tilt. Plan vehicles in white, cameras in blue, dolls in red; initial geometry estimated from RGB.
Approach above wooden vehicle with left and light doll with right; finish downward wrist tilt while keeping clearance.
Align left jaws across the wooden car and right jaws across doll torso; advance slowly and lower toward pregrasp.
Use wrist views to center car and doll torso between jaws, with a slow final downward approach.
Close left on centered car and lift to test retention; recenter right onto doll torso before closing.
Car remained on table: reopen and approach lower for side contact. Lift right slowly to check whether doll is retained.
Close lower on car and test lift. Right doll is visibly retained; carry it above the red basket with clearance.
Replan with smaller basket approach increments after right IK guard. Lower right gradually while carrying doll; lift retained car clear before translating.
Lower and release light doll into red. Carry wooden car fully over white basket before lowering for release.
Release wooden car in white and retreat both open grippers away from basket rims, preparing to collect bus and dark doll.
Move above remaining vehicle and dark doll in their respective workspaces, keeping downward grasp orientations and open jaws.
Fine approach to bus sidewalls and dark doll torso using wrist alignment; lower jaws to grasp height before closing.
Center bus and dark doll between the jaws, close both grippers fully, then make a short retention-test lift.
Both objects move with the grippers. Lift bus and dark doll clear and carry toward their established white and red category baskets.
Bus remains retained; position it over white basket. Dark doll slipped onto the table, so return right open above its new upright position for a better grasp.
Release bus inside white basket and withdraw. Approach dark doll again, this time toward its broader head region for improved retention.
Vehicles are in white. Move left above first camera. Recenter right around the dark doll's head without descending into its ears.
Lower left around the camera's sidewalls. Raise right to clear doll ears, then align open jaws with the wider head rather than the narrow torso.
Close left around camera and test lifting. Advance right to center the dark doll's head, descend slightly, then close around the wider head.
Camera is retained; carry left toward blue. Right closure was above the doll: reopen and lower slowly around its head, with a small backward correction.
After IK guard, avoid further left extension: tilt the held camera forward over blue while lowering slightly. Recenter right backward onto doll head, then close.
Lift left camera away from blue rim before advancing farther. Test dark doll head grasp with a slow vertical lift; retention remains uncertain.
First camera is visibly inside blue; open and withdraw left. Reopen right and align with dark doll's head using wrist view before another closure.
Lower open right jaws around centered doll head, close, and begin a small lift. Withdraw left toward its home workspace while gradually restoring orientation.
Right fingers closed above the head; reopen and lower another few centimeters for actual side contact. Continue left's gradual return toward origin.
Test the lower head grasp with a slow vertical lift, keeping right closed. Finish left's return to its origin pose.
Dark doll is now visibly lifted. Carry it toward red with a gentle forward wrist tilt to retain elbow-up reach margin; left stays at origin.
Move dark doll fully inside red basket beside the light doll, lower gently and release. Keep the other arm at origin.
Leave both dolls in red and retreat clear of the rim. Approach the remaining right-side camera with open, downward-facing jaws.
Use right wrist view to center the remaining camera between open jaws and descend toward its sidewalls; left stays home.
Lower right jaws to camera side contact, close fully, and begin a small lift to assess retention.
Camera remained on the table. Reopen and correct backward alignment from the wrist view before another sidewall grasp.
Camera is now between the jaws in the wrist view. Make a small centering correction, close, and test retention with a short lift.
The camera moves with the closed right gripper. Lift and carry it toward the blue category basket, adding a gentle forward tilt to preserve reach margin.
Carry the retained camera over the right half of blue, staying on the right side and lowering gradually with forward tilt.
Lower and release the second camera inside blue, then withdraw open fingers without contacting the basket rim.
Both cameras are visible settled in blue, vehicles in white, and dolls in red. Withdraw the open right arm toward origin while restoring its wrist orientation.
Return the right arm close to its original pose with continuous elbow-up motion, both grippers open; allow the sorted objects to settle.
